## Downloads

- `SpineViewerWPF-<version>-win-x64.zip`: desktop viewer. Extract and run
  `SpineViewerWPF.exe`; no .NET installation is required.
- `SpineViewerWPF-CLI-<version>-win-x64.zip`: command-line `spineviewerwpf.exe`.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksums for both packages.

Requires Windows 10/11 x64. An OpenGL-capable GPU is recommended; the viewer
falls back to CPU rendering. FFmpeg is not bundled.

The executables are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first
launch.

**Spine license:** this software integrates the Spine Runtimes. Each user must
hold their own [Spine Editor license](https://esotericsoftware.com/spine-editor-license).
License texts are in `licenses/` and `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` inside each package.
